Rem and her twin sister Ram were born into the oni tribe at a time when twins were considered ill-omened and were supposed to be killed. They were treated as outcasts until Ram’s extraordinary talent and powerful horn became apparent, winning the tribe’s admiration. Rem, by contrast, saw herself as ordinary and lived in Ram’s shadow, loving and admiring her while feeling painfully inadequate beside her. [3][4]

When the tribe was attacked, Ram shielded Rem and lost her horn. Rem’s first thought was that the horn she had envied had finally broken off. She was horrified by that thought, and her guilt deepened as she watched Ram struggle afterward. [2][1]

Rem resolved to live as though she were taking Ram’s place, trying to do everything her sister would have done. She devoted herself to that ideal, but felt she could never measure up. [5]
